kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
wire.summary: In an unprecedented step, European nations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

wire.title: Trump says he 'may' pull Blanche AG nomination temporarily
wire.summary: The news comes as two key Republicans are withholding their support over concerns about the Justice Department's deal with President Trump.

wire.title: The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend
wire.summary: The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.

wire.title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court to hold its first-ever hearing after 30 years
wire.summary: Congress created the Alien Terrorist Removal Court in 1996 to make it easier for the Justice Department to use classified evidence to deport people from U.S. soil.

wire.title: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
wire.summary: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.

wire.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least 8 civilians and wound dozens
wire.summary: The blitz expanded Russia's almost daily bombardment of Ukrainian cities as Moscow apparently looked to exploit Kyiv's critical shortage of Western-supplied anti-ballistic missile defenses.

wire.title: The Lumbee Tribe of N.C. wants better healthcare, but plans to fund it are in limbo
wire.summary: Robeson County, N.C., where most of the Lumbee Tribe's citizens live, ranks as one of the worst counties in the U.S. for health. The tribe can access the Indian Health Service now, but it's not likely to be sufficient to improve the health of the community.

wire.title: The renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever, as many are priced out of buying
wire.summary: Housing has long been the largest source of wealth for middle income families. But many renters cannot afford to buy as housing prices soar, which could fuel a generational divide.

wire.title: Pediatricians and health officials are sidestepping Trump's CDC on vaccine advice
wire.summary: The Trump administration's upending of years of vaccine advice puts many pediatricians in a quandary. Some are steering patients away from the CDC to other authoritative websites, including their own.

wire.title: The Trump administration has undercut the U.S. asylum program. These 3 charts show how
wire.summary: A new rule for asylum applications adds to the bevy of changes under the Trump administration to the core program for those fleeing persecution in their home countries.

wire.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
wire.summary: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

wire.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
wire.summary: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

wire.title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
wire.summary: The territory's leader said the influx is overwhelming resources and urged the Spanish government to intervene.

wire.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
wire.summary: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

wire.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
wire.summary: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

wire.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
wire.summary: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.
